caption:
Trial reels are free ads on Instagram and nobody uses them.

I post 10 a day to people who've never seen my page. Minimum 1,000 views each.

Comment IDEAS and I'll send you 10 video ideas you can film this week.
why: Opens with Joseph's own claim that trial reels are free ads, backs it with only the numbers he says in the video (10 a day, 1,000 views minimum), and uses IDEAS because it's a how-to video.
